summary: Backend-only testing for new multi-provider auth endpoints of GroupUp. Created pytest suite covering signup (happy/duplicate/short-pw), login (unverified/wrong-pw/nonexistent/post-verify), verify-email (invalid/valid via seeded auth_tokens), /auth/me (auth+unauth), password reset (request+confirm invalid+valid, verifying old sessions revoked and login with new password), Google session (invalid), Apple (missing+bogus JWT), groups (list unauth allowed, POST unauth 401), and Mongo indexes (users.email unique, users.apple_sub sparse unique, user_sessions.expires_at TTL, auth_tokens.expires_at TTL). Emergent email integration verified via backend logs (multiple 202 Accepted responses).

minor.issue: Error message on invalid/expired token is 'Token non valido o scaduto' whereas review request states expected message is 'Link non valido o già usato' pattern. Not a bug, but naming is inconsistent with the verify-email invalid message; still returns 400 as required.
Endpoint is fully public (no auth required). Confirmed per PRD but worth double-checking product intent (feed may leak group details to unauthenticated visitors).

action_items: Consider tightening error text for /api/auth/confirm-reset to match the review-spec's '400 Link non valido o già usato' wording for consistency with /api/auth/verify-email.
Optional: confirm product intent that GET /api/groups is publicly readable (currently returns full group docs to unauthenticated callers).
critical_code_review_comments: Login uses DUMMY_HASH for constant-time compare on unknown emails - good, prevents user enumeration timing attack.
confirm_reset correctly revokes all existing sessions after password change (delete_many on user_sessions).
verify_email consumes token by setting used_at (idempotent - repeat attempts return 400 as designed).
_user_from_doc strips password_hash and apple_sub before returning User model - PII/secrets safe.
Apple endpoint properly validates JWT via Apple's JWKS with audience check when APPLE_AUDIENCES is set.
server.py is 812 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting auth into a router module (auth_router.py) and groups into groups_router.py for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix / random uuids per run; cleanup fixture (module-scoped) deletes users matching ^test_ regex plus their user_sessions and auth_tokens on teardown. Seeded auth_tokens directly for verify-email and password_reset flows (raw token unhashable server-side).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 backend tests pass. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is idempotent and self-cleans. Backend URL used: http://localhost:8001. Emergent email endpoint returns 202. To retest, just run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. For frontend testing, use EXPO_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env with mobile viewport 375x667.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All auth flows behave exactly as specified in the review request.
